title: The starRating widget doesn't return the right facet counts and results.
body:
Using the starRating widget I've found that the facet counts and the hits returned don't match the selected number of stars.

For instance here, it says that there are 12 results with 4 stars and more, but in the end, when selecting this filter, it shows 14 hits, and not 12.
![image](http://g.recordit.co/TSuFW2ohub.gif)

The version with the bug can be accessed at http://educated-cherries.surge.sh/default\_version/?q=go%20pro\&hPP=10\&idx=bestbuy\&p=0\&dFR%5Bfree\_shipping%5D%5B0%5D=false\&is\_v=1
